<?php

namespace Illuminate\Support;

use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Arrayable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Htmlable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Support\Jsonable;
use JsonSerializable;
use Stringable;

class Js implements Htmlable, Stringable
{
    /**
     * The JavaScript string.
     *
     * @var string
     */
    protected $js;

    /**
     * Flags that should be used when encoding to JSON.
     *
     * @var int
     */
    protected const REQUIRED_FLAGS = JSON_HEX_TAG | JSON_HEX_APOS | JSON_HEX_AMP | JSON_HEX_QUOT | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR;

    /**
     * Create a new class instance.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int|null  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return void
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    public function __construct($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        $this->js = $this->convertDataToJavaScriptExpression($data, $flags, $depth);
    }

    /**
     * Create a new JavaScript string from the given data.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return static
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    public static function from($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        return new static($data, $flags, $depth);
    }

    /**
     * Convert the given data to a JavaScript expression.
     *
     * @param  mixed  $data
     * @param  int  $flags
     * @param  int  $depth
     * @return string
     *
     * @throws \JsonException
     */
    protected function convertDataToJavaScriptExpression($data, $flags = 0, $depth = 512)
    {
        if ($data instanceof self) {
            return $data->toHtml();
        }

        $data = enum_value($data);

        $json = static::encode($data, $flags, $depth);

        $encodingFlags = $flags | static::REQUIRED_FLAGS;
        $unescapedSlashes = ($encodingFlags & JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES) === JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES;
        $unescapedUnicode = ($encodingFlags & JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) === JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE;
        $hexTag = ($encodingFlags & JSON_HEX_TAG) === JSON_HEX_TAG;
        $hexApos = ($encodingFlags & JSON_HEX_APOS) === JSON_HEX_APOS;
        $hexAmp = ($encodingFlags & JSON_HEX_AMP) === JSON_HEX_AMP;
        $hexQuot = ($encodingFlags & JSON_HEX_QUOT) === JSON_HEX_QUOT;

        $replacements = [
            '\\' => '\\\\',
            '/' => '\\/',
            '"' => '\\"',
        ];

        if ($unescapedSlashes) {
            $replacements['/'] = '/';
        }

        if ($hexQuot) {
            $replacements['"'] = '\\u0022';
        }

        if ($hexTag) {
            $replacements['<'] = '\\u003C';
            $replacements['>'] = '\\u003E';
        }

        if ($hexAmp) {
            $replacements['&'] = '\\u0026';
        }

        if ($hexApos) {
            $replacements["'"] = '\\u0027';
        }

        $escapeSource = null;
        $wrapAsJavaScriptString = false;
        $wrapAsJsonParse = false;
        $dataType = gettype($data);

        if ($dataType === 'string') {
            $escapeSource = $data;
            $wrapAsJavaScriptString = true;
        } elseif ($dataType === 'NULL') {
            return $json;
        } elseif ($dataType === 'boolean') {
            return $json;
        } elseif ($dataType === 'integer') {
            return $json;
        } elseif ($dataType === 'double') {
            return $json;
        } else {
            $normalized = $data;

            if ($data instanceof JsonSerializable) {
                $serialized = $data->jsonSerialize();
                $serializedType = gettype($serialized);

                if ($serializedType === 'array') {
                    $normalized = $serialized;
                } elseif ($serializedType === 'object') {
                    $normalized = get_object_vars($serialized);
                }
            } elseif ($data instanceof Arrayable) {
                $normalized = $data->toArray();
            } elseif (is_object($data)) {
                $normalized = get_object_vars($data);
            }

            $normalizedType = gettype($normalized);

            if ($normalizedType === 'array') {
                if (Arr::accessible($normalized)) {
                    $collectionView = collect($normalized);

                    if ($collectionView->isEmpty()) {
                        if ($json === '[]') {
                            return $json;
                        }

                        if ($json === '{}') {
                            return $json;
                        }
                    } else {
                        $canRebuild = true;
                        $rebuilt = null;

                        if (Arr::isList($normalized)) {
                            $parts = [];

                            foreach ($normalized as $index => $item) {
                                $item = data_get($normalized, $index, $item);
                                $itemType = gettype($item);

                                if ($itemType === 'array') {
                                    $canRebuild = false;
                                    break;
                                } elseif ($itemType === 'object') {
                                    $canRebuild = false;
                                    break;
                                } else {
                                    $parts[] = static::encode($item, $flags, $depth);
                                }
                            }

                            if ($canRebuild) {
                                $rebuilt = '['.implode(',', $parts).']';
                            }
                        } else {
                            $assocParts = [];

                            foreach ($normalized as $key => $item) {
                                if (Arr::exists($normalized, $key)) {
                                    $item = data_get($normalized, $key, $item);
                                    $itemType = gettype($item);
                                    $encodedKey = static::encode((string) $key, $flags, $depth);

                                    if ($itemType === 'array') {
                                        $canRebuild = false;
                                        break;
                                    } elseif ($itemType === 'object') {
                                        $canRebuild = false;
                                        break;
                                    } else {
                                        $assocParts[] = $encodedKey.':'.static::encode($item, $flags, $depth);
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    $canRebuild = false;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }

                            if ($canRebuild) {
                                $rebuilt = '{'.implode(',', $assocParts).'}';
                            }
                        }

                        if ($canRebuild) {
                            if ($rebuilt === $json) {
                                $json = $rebuilt;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                if ($json === '[]') {
                    return $json;
                }

                if ($json === '{}') {
                    return $json;
                }
            }

            $needsParse = false;
            $prefixNeedles = ['"', '{', '['];

            if (is_string($json)) {
                foreach ($prefixNeedles as $needle) {
                    if ($needle !== '') {
                        if (str_starts_with($json, $needle)) {
